name: Bassment
description: Multi-genre monophonic basslines with bassist Voice personas

sections.heading: Faders
items: Alt — Genre scrub (shared axis with Grooves / Chord Vamp)
Third — Feel / Groove (swing · microtiming · velocity · ghosts · gate; capped by Groove max %)

sections.heading: Genres
items: Dub → Disco → House → Techno → Trip-Hop → Hip-Hop → Jungle → UK Garage → Dubstep
Alt scrub LEDs: continuous IR→UV spectrum (shared palette)

sections.heading: Buttons
items: Shift+Tap — Bass fill into next bar’s chord (pedal break at high Density); white button LED
Shift+Hold — Bass solo (+1–2 oct), re-rolls each bar; resolves on the next downbeat
Previous Voice / Swing Dir: Configurator only

sections.heading: Jack params
items: Jack: CV Out (pitch V/Oct) / CV In
CV Dest: Density · Feel · Reset (Configurator) — Reset now lives here only

sections.heading: Voices / LEDs
items: Order = historical era: bebop → Motown → P-Funk → fusion → dub duo → alt-funk → quirk
Button: genre hue in play; Long flash = voice color; fill/solo = white (dim = pedal break); hits duck Mid→Low
